title: Janet Airlines first heard of through Lazar

tellings.quote: where did we first hear about Janet Airlines? Bob Lazar.

plain: The first public mention of "Janet Airlines", the nickname for unmarked passenger planes said to fly workers to secret test sites in Nevada, came from a man named Bob Lazar, who in 1989 claimed he had worked on alien craft there. That is how a UFO researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb puts it to Michels. He asks where the name was first heard and answers his own question: "Bob Lazar." If so, Lazar knew details of the secret Nevada world that only insiders would know.
